source.revision: Code accompanying this IR; baseline 0a949cf12f226a63b0db6244f9fc2a1e3fef78d1 plus accepted journey changes, reviewed 2026-11-16
source.description: Source-derived current behavior, including the accepted Retry, Settings review and pointer-open changes. Fixed fictional fixtures; no live provider requests. Affected browser flows and native offline checks passed. Scaffold: repo-kit 4914a36.

included: Native Write with a valid connected preset and one fictional question. Min Mode is the primary presentation.
Run, initial-write blocking, completion, Stop, failure, save-only recovery, follow-up, reuse, export and delete.
Quick Lookup handoff preserves an active request; closing a view does not cancel it.
Reviewed layout hints group navigation contexts and route/recovery neighborhoods; coordinates are presentation only, not time or rank.
Failed/stopped text and image requests have direct Retry in both windows. Initial-save, connection, model and saved-image checks remain before generation.
omitted: Connection setup, preset editing and image work are separate maps.
Raycast, Services, global shortcut permission prompts and every concurrent history/hidden-window combination are not expanded.
Save failure of a completed text answer is expanded; unsaved failed/interrupted variants use the same owner but are not separate fixtures.
A finite scenario projection, not the full Cartesian product of app state. System buttons simulate possible source-code outcomes.
No proposed optimization: Comparison is intentionally absent.

Terminal landmarks end this scoped review; they do not imply that the real application quits. Compound navigation labels name their menu/section steps; route counts are model transitions, not measured click counts.
The detailed Retry blocked notice is not a separate landmark: it retains the failed result and offers Review saved request. Tests cover changed account, missing image and initial-save failure.
